name: landing-page-design
description: Build landing pages and websites that look professionally designed, not AI-generated. Library-agnostic instruction that guides the agent through a strict pattern (domain -> sections -> per-section content -> components -> assets -> tokens -> build) and points at current shadcn-compatible registries (shadcn, Magic UI, Aceternity, Kibo UI, Launch UI, Skiper, 21st.dev, and whatever else is trending) to discover live.
